Brand Introduction
DailyDripz is a dynamic dropshipping store  delivering premium home decor and wellness products as well as various products for customers comfy  in the US. At dailydripzofficial.store, we’re passionate about enhancing everyday living with stylish, high-quality items that bring comfort and elegance to homes. Our mission is to provide curated products that inspire relaxation and elevate interior spaces, backed by seamless shopping experiences and exceptional customer support.

Product Description
Our catalog features a carefully selected range of massage chairs and home decor products. From luxurious, ergonomic massage chairs designed to relieve stress and promote wellness to chic home accents like decorative vases, wall art, and cozy textiles, DailyDripz offers something for every home. Our products combine modern design with functionality, catering to customers seeking comfort, style, and quality in their living spaces.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  • Curated Wellness & Style: We specialize in trending massage chairs and home decor, offering unique products that blend relaxation with aesthetic appeal, perfect for health-conscious and design-savvy US customers.

  • Competitive Pricing: Our dropshipping model ensures affordable luxury without compromising quality, giving affiliates high-converting products to promote.

  • Global Reach, Local Focus: Based in Nepal but tailored for the US market, we provide fast shipping and responsive support, ensuring customer satisfaction and repeat purchases.

Payment Terms
Affiliates earn competitive commissions on every sale generated through their unique referral links. Payments are processed monthly via secure methods like paypal,  bank transfer, ensuring timely and transparent payouts. Commission rates are tiered based on performance, with top affiliates earning up to 35% per sale. No minimum payout threshold—start earning from your first conversion! Detailed tracking and reporting are available through the UpPromote dashboard.

Other Information

  • Target Audience: US-based homeowners, wellness enthusiasts, and interior design lovers aged 25-55.

  • Marketing Support: Affiliates receive access to banners, product images, and promotional content to boost conversions.

  • Program Flexibility: No long-term commitments—join or pause anytime. Suitable for bloggers, influencers, and content creators in home decor, wellness, or lifestyle niches.

  • Contact: Reach our affiliate team at dailydripz52@gmail.com  for personalized assistance or inquiries.
    Sign up today to partner with DailyDripz and monetize your audience with products that sell themselves!
